description: This file implements a SQL store for managing scheduled posts in Mattermost, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting scheduled posts, with methods for handling database interactions and queries.

classes.name: SqlScheduledPostStore
classes.description: A struct that manages scheduled post data in SQL database, providing methods for CRUD operations and query handling.

methods.name: newScheduledPostStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlScheduledPostStore instance.

methods.name: columnsForWrite
methods.description: Returns column names for writing scheduled post data to the database.

methods.name: columnsForRead
methods.description: Returns column names for reading scheduled post data from the database.

methods.name: CreateScheduledPost
methods.description: Inserts a new scheduled post into the database.

methods.name: GetScheduledPostsForUser
methods.description: Fetches scheduled posts for a specific user and team.

methods.name: GetMaxMessageSize
methods.description: Determines the maximum size allowed for the message field.

methods.name: GetPendingScheduledPosts
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled posts pending to be sent before and after specified times.

methods.name: PermanentlyDeleteScheduledPosts
methods.description: Deletes scheduled posts by their IDs permanently from the database.

methods.name: UpdatedScheduledPost
methods.description: Updates an existing scheduled post in the database.

methods.name: toUpdateMap
methods.description: Creates a map of fields to update for a scheduled post.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a scheduled post by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateOldScheduledPosts
methods.description: Marks old scheduled posts as failed if they haven't been sent.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Deletes all scheduled posts associated with a specific user.
